name: Mozi (Mo Di)
shortBio: Ancient Chinese philosopher and founder of Mohism, who formulated the doctrine of universal mutual care (jian'ai), anti-militarism, early consequentialism, and the 'Three Models' of epistemological logic.
centralQuestion: How can society eliminate war, poverty, and injustice through universal mutual care and rational consequentialist governance?

keyWorks.title: Mozi (The Book of Master Mo)
keyWorks.description: Foundational text of Mohism containing treatises on universal care (jian'ai), non-aggression (feigong), frugality, and early logic.
